records.institution: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
records.name: Peter Bebersdorf
records.note: Page writes the name as 'Dr. Peter Bebersdorf'. News item dated 30 June 2023 (Lehrstuhl für Produktionsmanagement): on 21 June 2023 Prof. Dr. Nils Boysen (2. Vorsitzender, IWA e.V., Friedrich-Schiller-Universität Jena; Initiative Wissenschaft und Automobilindustrie) awarded him the prize for the best application-oriented dissertation 'Varianz beherrschen mit variabler Taktung und dem VarioTakt'. The year recorded is the prize date; the defense/graduation year is not stated. At the time of the award the page describes him as 'Director Manufacturing Tractor bei AGCO-Fendt in Marktoberdorf' (affiliation at award time, not labelled as a placement; the concept was implemented in Fendt tractor production, which suggests an industry-based doctorate).

records.institution: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
records.name: Sebastian Doetsch
records.note: News item dated 24 April 2023 (Lehrstuhl für Produktionsmanagement): on Friday 21 April 2023 he successfully defended his dissertation 'Maßgeschneiderte Supply Chain Resilienz' (English: 'Bespoke Supply Chain Resilience'). Co-supervisor (Co-Betreuerin): Junior-Professorin Marjolein Buisman; the reference list shows Arnd Huchzermeier as co-author on all listed publications (chair holder not named explicitly as supervisor). Year recorded is the defense year. Publications listed: JOM 2022 'Bespoke supply-chain resilience: The gap between theory and practice', Springer chapter 2022, Management & Business Review 2023 (forthcoming), Supply Chain Management Review 2022, SSRN working paper 2023 with Huchzermeier. No placement stated.

records.institution: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
records.name: Jan-Rasmus Künnen
records.note: News item dated 05/10/2023 (Doctoral Program): on May 2, 2023 he defended his PhD thesis 'Advanced demand-capacity balancing mechanisms to improve the performance of European air traffic networks', evaluated summa cum laude. Year recorded is the defense year. The page states: 'After completing his PhD studies at WHU, Jan-Rasmus initially returned to McKinsey & Company as a Senior Associate. In 2023 he started his own company, Wing Labs GmbH, to continue developing and implementing optimization tools for (air) transportation.' ('returned' implies prior McKinsey employment before the PhD). Supervisor not named; co-author on all three listed papers is Arne (K.) Strauss. Papers: Transportation Research Part B 2022; Transportation Science (forthcoming, accepted April 2023); Transportation Research Part A (forthcoming).

records.institution: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
records.name: Ole Frauen
records.note: News item dated 05/10/2023 (Doctoral Program): on May 5th, 2023 he successfully defended his thesis 'Managing Distributed and Complex Product Development Projects: The Effect of Work Design and Product Architecture on Process Quality'. Year recorded is the defense year. The page writes him as 'Ole Frauen (Volkswagen Group, Wolfsburg, Germany)' at the time of the defense: an affiliation during the doctorate, not labelled as a placement. The page thanks 'Professor Jürgen Mihm from INSEAD for the close and intense research collaboration' (not named as supervisor). No placement stated.

records.institution: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
records.name: Philip von Wedel
records.note: News item 'Dissertation in Digital Health Economics' dated 12/23/2022: 'Congratulations to Philip von Wedel for finishing his doctoral studies with a successful disputation.' Year recorded is the disputation/news date year. The page lists the three dissertation papers: 'Economic Value of Data and Analytics for Health Care Providers: Hermeneutic Systematic Literature Review'; 'Physicians' preferences and willingness to pay for artificial intelligence-based assistance tools: a discrete choice experiment among German radiologists'; 'Effects of Hospital Digitization on Clinical Outcomes and Patient Satisfaction: Nationwide Multiple Regression Analysis Across German Hospitals'. No supervisor, chair, degree or placement stated (page category shown as 'Excludes').

records.institution: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
records.name: Devadrita Nair
records.destination: Massachusetts Institute of Technology's Digital Supply Chain Transformation Department
records.note: Headline writes 'Ms. Devadrita Nair'. News item dated 05/19/2023 (Doctoral Program): on May 17th, 2023 she successfully defended her dissertation 'Human-Machine Forecasting for E-Commerce'. Year recorded is the defense year. For more than three years her work was supported by Canyon Bicycles GmbH (Koblenz). The page states: 'Ms. Nair will join Massachusetts Institute of Technology's Digital Supply Chain Transformation Department on June 1st' (year not written; context is 2023; no title given). Supervisor not named.

notes: All six pages are single-person WHU news items (Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2023-40 captures, one snapshot each; no live copy in the chunk), so each yields one record. Four are dissertation-defense announcements (Doetsch 21 Apr 2023, Künnen 2 May 2023, Frauen 5 May 2023, Nair 17 May 2023), one a disputation announcement (von Wedel, news dated 23 Dec 2022) and one a best-dissertation prize (Bebersdorf, prize 21 Jun 2023). listedYear is the defense/disputation year with yearMeaning 'graduation' for the five defenses; for Bebersdorf it is the prize year with yearMeaning 'unstated' because the page never gives the defense year. Degrees are left null except Künnen ('PhD thesis' on the page); WHU doctoral degrees are not named on the other pages. Current affiliations stated at defense/award time (Frauen: Volkswagen Group, Wolfsburg; Bebersdorf: Director Manufacturing Tractor at AGCO-Fendt, Marktoberdorf) are kept in note only, not as destination, because the pages do not present them as placements. Destinations recorded only where the page states a post-PhD move: Künnen (returned to McKinsey & Company as Senior Associate; founded Wing Labs GmbH in 2023) and Nair (joining MIT's Digital Supply Chain Transformation Department on June 1st, year implied 2023). Program is the posting chair/category shown on the page ('Lehrstuhl für Produktionsmanagement' on the two German pages, 'Doctoral Program' on three English pages, none for von Wedel). The German pages are the Chair of Production Management (Huchzermeier) news feed; the English pages do not name the chair. Names recorded without honorifics ('Dr.', 'Ms.'), as noted per record. Navigation shells list WHU faculty chairs only; no other graduates appear.
